authority: Alpha-first continuation approved by the user; one bounded lifecycle hypothesis after acquisition-state attribution rejected further entry gates.
control: Unchanged research.trend_book.Owner with Parameters(2), freshly run on the same source, data, universe, costs and delay as treatment.
hypothesis: A funded campaign that closes below its actual acquisition basis and below its causal forty-session EMA for two consecutive completed sessions has failed as owned capital. Latching the existing security exit at that point should remove a sparse set of adverse broad-scope campaigns without truncating mature compounders.

fixed_event.basis: Observed actual opening fills only. First fill sets basis; later filled additions update the weighted basis. Targets, unfilled orders and sales never rewrite basis. Full liquidation clears it.
fixed_event.trend: close < EMA40, computed from supplied-universe adjusted closes through the current completed session
fixed_event.confirmation: loss and trend are both true on two consecutive completed sessions while actual units remain held
fixed_event.action: Latch the parent's existing full security exit for that symbol. The normal next-session execution, blocked-fill retry, sellable inventory, fees, lots and cash accounting remain unchanged.
fixed_event.parameters: NONE beyond frozen Config.slow=40 and the two-close confirmation already fixed here

boundaries: No market, account, breadth, theme, ticker or supplied-pool condition
No new entry, ranking, funding, capacity, risk cap or reentry rule
Existing parent security exits and protection remain higher/equal priority and cannot be forgiven
No future campaign payoff, reference source, 2026 result or open/censored campaign enters the rule
No neighboring EMA span, confirmation length, basis margin or partial-exit search

preimplementation_evidence.limitation: Retrospective state attribution on selected actual campaigns, not an executable counterfactual or independent acceptance result.

screen: Fresh matched control/treatment through 2025-12-31 for union, common-five and joint optical-leader removal. Every scope wealth must be nondecreasing and at least one strictly higher; record MDD, fills, turnover, exposure, event count and ledger residual. Failure ends the family without parameter search or 2026 replay.
advance: Only a passed three-scope alpha screen may advance the same source to the original full acceptance matrix.
